items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
items_flat.title_zh: Google推出Gemini 3.8 Live與3.8 Live Extended Thinking
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, calling them its most advanced live dialogue models. Live is positioned for scale and cost; Extended Thinking for multi-step spoken tasks, with background tool calls and near-real-time visual grounding. Both are rolling out in the Gemini app and, for developers, via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google宣布推出Gemini 3.8 Live與Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking，稱為目前最先進的即時對話模型。Live主打規模與成本，Extended Thinking主打多步驟口語任務，支援背景工具呼叫與近即時視覺理解。兩者已開始在Gemini應用推出，開發者可經Gemini API與Google AI Studio使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a product-layer audio release, not a new general-purpose flagship. The open question is whether background tool-calling while speaking holds up in production voice agents versus lab demos and cited speech benchmarks.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是語音產品層更新，不是新一代通用旗艦。關鍵不確定性在於「邊說邊在背景呼叫工具」在真實語音客服／代理人場景能否站穩，而非只在官方引用的語音基準上好看。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking – our best conversational AI. The models talk, think, and handle tasks in the background without breaking your flow.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出Gemini 3.8 Live與3.8 Live Extended Thinking——目前最好的對話式AI。模型能說話、思考，並在不打斷對話的情況下於背景處理任務。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI says it has been talking with Anthropic and Google on AI safety
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI稱已與Anthropic、Google就AI安全展開討論
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI global affairs chief Chris Lehane told reporters the company has been engaging Anthropic and Google DeepMind on AI safety for several weeks. An OpenAI spokesperson told CNBC the talks follow Demis Hassabis’s July proposal for a U.S.-linked standards body. Reuters and Bloomberg reported Lehane saying coordination on safety should not require an antitrust waiver.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI全球事務主管Chris Lehane向記者表示，公司數週來一直與Anthropic、Google DeepMind討論AI安全。OpenAI發言人向CNBC證實，討論延續Hassabis七月提出的美國標準機構構想。路透與彭博引述Lehane稱，安全協調不必先取得反壟斷豁免。
items_flat.analysis_en: The confirmation is political, not a shipped standard: no joint eval suite, pause rule, or third-party auditor mandate was published with the briefing. Antitrust risk and how far rivals will actually share model access remain unresolved.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是政策層確認，不是已落地的共同標準：簡報未附聯合評測套件、暫停規則或強制第三方審計。反壟斷風險、以及對手實際會共享多少模型權限，仍未解決。
items_flat.quote: It's better to try to work together to prioritize safety.
items_flat.quote_zh: 最好試著合作，把安全放在優先位置。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands Claude for Small Business with new workflows and connectors
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic擴充Claude中小企業版工作流與接線
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic said Claude for Small Business now includes 43 workflows and 27 new integrations, adding Shopify, Salesforce, Zoom, Xero, Gusto, Square, Stripe, Zapier and others. The company said the May package has been installed more than 900,000 times and is pairing the update with free U.S. workshops and partner webinars. Workflows still start in approval mode before send, post, or pay actions.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic表示，Claude中小企業版現有43個工作流與27項新整合，新增Shopify、Salesforce、Zoom、Xero、Gusto、Square、Stripe、Zapier等。公司稱五月套件安裝量已逾90萬，並搭配美國免費工作坊與合作夥伴網路研討會。工作流預設仍須人工核准後才會寄出、發文或付款。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is distribution and connectors, not a new Claude model. Whether 900k installs convert into recurring paid Cowork use is not disclosed in the post.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是通路與連接器擴張，不是新Claude模型。貼文未說明90萬次安裝有多少轉成持續付費的Cowork使用。
items_flat.quote: Claude for Small Business now includes 43 workflows and 27 new integrations with tools small businesses already use, including Shopify, Salesforce, TikTok, Atlassian, Zoom, Xero, Gusto, Square, Stripe, and Zapier.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude中小企業版現包含43個工作流，以及27項中小企業既有工具的新整合，包括Shopify、Salesforce、TikTok、Atlassian、Zoom、Xero、Gusto、Square、Stripe與Zapier。

items_flat.title_en: Meta ships WhatsApp Business Tools MCP for coding agents
items_flat.title_zh: Meta推出WhatsApp商業工具MCP供編程代理人使用
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced WhatsApp Business Tools MCP, a remote MCP server that lets agents such as Claude, Cursor, Codex, and ChatGPT set up and manage WhatsApp Business Platform assets. The server can create a business account, add and OTP-verify a number, manage templates and webhooks, and send test messages. Meta said it is for development and testing, not production-scale sending.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta宣布WhatsApp Business Tools MCP，讓Claude、Cursor、Codex、ChatGPT等代理人直接設定與管理WhatsApp商業平台資產。伺服器可建立商業帳號、加號並OTP驗證、管理模板與webhook，並發送測試訊息。Meta明言此版本用於開發與測試，不是大規模正式發送。
items_flat.analysis_en: Giving coding agents write access to WhatsApp onboarding shortens setup, but it also concentrates account-creation and template risk in whatever agent the developer already trusts.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 讓編程代理人寫入WhatsApp開通流程能縮短設定，但也把開戶與模板風險集中在開發者已信任的那個代理人上。
items_flat.quote: This release is built for development and testing workflows, not production sending at scale.
items_flat.quote_zh: 此版本用於開發與測試工作流，而非大規模正式發送。

items_flat.title_en: Meta introduces Meta One paid bundles for apps and AI usage
items_flat.title_zh: Meta推出Meta One訂閱方案捆綁應用與AI用量
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced Meta One, combining Instagram Plus, Facebook Plus, and WhatsApp Plus features with higher caps on compute-heavy Meta AI media generation powered by Muse models. Individual Core and Premium plans are listed at $9.99 and $19.99 per month in the post’s plan table, with separate Essential/business bundles starting at $14.99. Meta said everyday Meta AI remains free.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta宣布Meta One，把Instagram Plus、Facebook Plus、WhatsApp Plus功能與Muse模型驅動的高算力AI媒體生成額度捆在一起。官宣方案表列出個人Core與Premium月費9.99與19.99美元，另有14.99美元起的商家／創作者方案。Meta稱日常Meta AI仍免費。
items_flat.analysis_en: This monetizes Muse generation inside the social apps rather than shipping a new research model. Conversion will depend on whether users hit free-tier media limits often enough to pay.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是把Muse生成能力在社交應用內變現，不是新研究模型。轉換關鍵在於免費額度是否常被用滿。
items_flat.quote: Meta AI will still be free for everyday use — Core and Premium are for people who want even more creative freedom from our AI tools.
items_flat.quote_zh: 日常使用的Meta AI仍然免費——Core與Premium是給想從AI工具獲得更多創作空間的人。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral and TotalEnergies launch €100M+ reservoir AI program
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral與TotalEnergies啟動逾一億歐元油氣儲層AI計畫
items_flat.summary_en: TotalEnergies and Mistral announced a three-year joint program of more than €100 million to build frontier models for oil-and-gas reservoir exploration, characterization, and development. The companies will stand up a joint scientific lab pairing TotalEnergies subsurface teams with Mistral, citing nearly 10 petaflops of data and a century of geoscience practice. Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch framed it as customizable industrial AI that keeps customer IP.
items_flat.summary_zh: TotalEnergies與Mistral宣布三年、逾一億歐元的聯合計畫，要為油氣儲層探勘、定性與開發打造前沿模型。雙方將成立聯合科學實驗室，結合TotalEnergies地下團隊與Mistral，並提及近10 petaflops資料與近百年地質實務。Mistral執行長Arthur Mensch將其定位為可客製、且保護客戶智財的工業AI。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a vertical, closed-data build, not a public model drop. How much of the work is new training versus wrapping existing Mistral models on proprietary seismic and reservoir data is not specified.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是垂直、封閉資料的共建，不是公開發模型。有多少是新訓練、有多少只是把既有Mistral模型套在專有地震與儲層資料上，聲明並未寫清。
items_flat.quote: This project demonstrates the ability of our models to support complex industrial processes and adapt to the most demanding scientific and energy challenges.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這個專案證明我們的模型能支援複雜工業流程，並適應最嚴苛的科學與能源挑戰。
